decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of the permission referenced 2022/0197 and dated 16 June 2023
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed Location plan, 501/201/2, 501/202/2, Anytime Fitness Battersea - Voluntary Noise Management Plan received 17/07/26, Noise & Vibration Assessment prepared by Air & Acoustic Consultants (dated May 2026), CLUB OPERATIONS INFORMATION SHEET, OS MAP .
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) or any Order revoking, amending and re-enacting the Order the development hereby approved be used only for Class E, excluding Class E(f) (Cr�che, day nursery or day centre), and for no other purpose of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification). 
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood by ensuring that other uses which could cause a loss of amenity do not commence without prior approval in accordance with the National Planning Policy Framework 2024.
Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with BREEAM Interim (Design Stage) Assessment approved under details application ref.2023/2505. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and thereafter so retained. 
Reason: To achieve appropriate sustainability standards in accordance with Council Policy LP10 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024. 

Condition : 5 - Within three months of the first occupation of the building a BREEAM New Construction Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the BRE (or equivalent accredited body), shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority to demonstrate that an Excellent rating has been achieved. All the measures integrated shall be retained for as long as the development is in existence. 
Reason: To achieve appropriate sustainability standards in accordance with Council policy LP10 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024. 
Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans and set out in the supporting information, the development hereby approved shall only operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week whilst the premises is used for fitness centre or other Class E(d) uses (Indoor sport or fitness use) and for no other purpose of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification). Any material change of use to another purpose shall require the written approval of the Local Planning Authority for hours of operation.
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood by ensuring that other uses which could cause a loss of amenity do not commence without prior approval in accordance with Council policies LP12 and LP14 of the Local Plan (2023), coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 7 - The development shall be completed in full accordance with the UNDA Flood Risk Assessment Report (Ref: 86085-280515-LRA-WorfieldSt, Draft v1.0240815), unless otherwise approved in advance by the local planning authority. To reduce the impact of flooding both to and from the proposed development and third parties, in order to comply with policy LP12 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) . 
Condition : 8 - Prior to the first occupation of the building, a fire statement shall be submitted
to and approved by the local planning authority. The development shall be built and operated in accordance with the approved statement. 
Reason: To ensure that adequate arrangements are made for fire safety in accordance with London Plan Policy D12 coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024.
Condition : 9 - Prior to commencement of the gym use, a detailed acoustic mitigation scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include:
- details of all floor construction systems beneath treadmills, free-weight areas,
functional training areas and any weightlifting equipment;
- details of independent acoustic ceiling systems;
- treatment of flanking transmission paths, columns, curtain wall interfaces and service penetrations;
- acoustic treatment to any pipework, ducts and service risers;
- details of speaker mounting arrangements.
The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and thereafter so retained. 
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policies LP12 and LP14 of the Local Plan (2023), coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 10 - Prior to commencement of the gym use, a noise control scheme for building services plant that will form part of the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority which demonstrates that the following noise design requirements can be complied with and shall thereafter be retained as approved.
The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the building services plant, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the mechanical system operates. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or 1 metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises in accordance with the latest British Standard 4142; An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown
on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria is achieved.
The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and thereafter so retained. 
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policies LP12 and LP14 of the Local Plan (2023), coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 11 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
description: Variation of condition 6 (Limited opening hours) of planning permission dated 16/06/2023 ref 2022/0197 (Change of use to the commercial unit at ground floor and part of the basement level from Office (Class B1a) to Commercial, Business, & Service Use (Class E).) to allow the operating hours to extend to a 24-hour basis.
